name: SSRF
attack_surface: Webhook endpoints, PDF generators, image import URLs, file upload forms accepting URLs
common_misconfigurations: Lack of network-level separation on internal resources
Missing protocol constraints (e.g. allowing file://, gopher://)
Failing to validate DNS resolution output (DNS rebinding vulnerability)
validation_methods: Use out-of-band monitoring tools (e.g., DNS/HTTP interactors)
evidence_requirements: Screenshot/logs of internal resource file/metadata readout
Timestamped out-of-band interactor hit logs matching injected request ID
false_positive_indicators: WAF blocking external resource reads and returning generic HTML errors
DNS resolution success on public servers without backend HTTP processing
reporting_guidance: High priority focus area. SSRF with internal metadata or private files readout represents a critical risk.
